decisions.document_is_PCR-007: PLAN, assumed until the owner says otherwise (D5): PCR-007, the CEX report. A full DoE report, no registered discrepancy, 88 quotes / 33 spans, mechanism file reviewed, and never read by the owner — so shipped and new can be read blind, which no re-read of PCR-003 or PCR-005 allows. Overrulable before TASK-002 runs; if the owner picks PCR-006/008/009, brief §5c carries a discrepancy assignment and TASKS.md item 7 applies.
decisions.regime: PROPOSAL + RUNNER.md as rebuilt: ONE agent, claude-opus-5, one pass, reading exactly the brief (with §2b, no §5d), section_plan.yaml (structure), STORY_BIBLE.md, WRITING_GUIDE.md (122 lines), REGISTER_EXEMPLAR.md, and _pcpkg.py / doe_report.py for signatures. No counter, no grep list, no checklist of moves. It runs check_render.py itself as the RUNNER says (tic gate + correctness), and it is shown nothing else. This differs from the probe in two ways, both intended: the exemplar is in (the probe left it out; the guide's §5 sends the author to five of its sections), and the agent writes its own SETUP chunk (a whole document cannot borrow one).
decisions.content_review_before_the_reading: PLAN: the four content questions run on the DRAFT before the owner reads it, with at most ONE return-to-author cycle, because that is the pipeline the proposal specifies (task 6) and the reading judges the pipeline's output. The judge's answers, before and after the cycle, are filed and go into the results page. Overrulable: if the owner wants to read the uncorrected draft, TASK-003 is skipped and its slot moves after TASK-004.
decisions.what_the_owner_reads: PLAN: two whole PDFs, A and B, blind (key drawn by secrets.choice before authoring, opened after the reading). The owner is offered a fixed subset — Executive summary, Results (all four subsections), Design space, Discussion — as the read, with the whole document available; every previous reading landed in Results. Whatever the owner reads, the same sections are read in both.
decisions.pass_rule: PLAN, fixed now and applied mechanically in TASK-004: PASS iff the owner judges the new document the better text AND quotes fewer than five sentences from it across whatever was read (the probe's rule was fewer than three in 90 sentences; the subset here is roughly 150–200 sentences, the whole document ~440). Anything else is FAIL. Recorded in D6.
decisions.promotion_on_pass: PLAN: a PASS promotes. The proposal says 'one whole document … before nineteen', which reads as ship it, then decide about the rest; a reading with no shipped document leaves the corpus where it was. On FAIL the draft stays in the unit as evidence and TASK-006/007 are cancelled.
decisions.no_counters_before_the_reading: PLAN, as in the probe: TASK-002's outcome records model, render, glyphs, <<NEEDS>>, sentence/word/page counts — no style row, no frame count. TASK-005 counts after the reading, in that order.
decisions.reading_outcome: UNSET — written by TASK-004 as PASS or FAIL with the date.

the agent ran check_render.py as the RUNNER says (correctness + tic gate) and fixed its own code errors and tic failures in the same context; the session printed no measure back to it and no line of its check_render output beyond what the tool prints (which, since 2026-08-19, is the five gated rows and pass/fail)

`uv run python authoring/check_render.py pc_package/PCR-007_cex.DRAFT.qmd --render` -> all chunks exec, all inline expressions eval, no <<NEEDS:>>, docx renders, tic gate OK; `cd pc_package && PATH="$PWD/../.venv/bin:$PATH" quarto render PCR-007_cex.DRAFT.qmd --to pdf` succeeds and check_render on the fresh pdf reports no missing glyph

`grep -c '<<NEEDS' pc_package/PCR-007_cex.DRAFT.qmd` -> 0; the typed-measurement grep (`grep -nE "\b[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s?(%|°C|mmHg|g/L|L\b|mM|h\b|cm/hr|CV\b|mS/cm|days?)"`) hits only inside inline expressions, table code or statistical conventions — every hit listed in the outcome

every section of section_plan.yaml report_doe is present in order (`grep -n '^# \|^## '` against the plan's headings), including Results §5.4 Mechanistic interpretation, Design space, PARs, Deviations (PCR-007 has seeded deviations — brief §5) and Appendices A–D

the outcome records ONLY: model, render result, glyph result, <<NEEDS>> count, sentence count, word count, page count, and how many check_render passes the agent needed — no style row, no frame count, no discourse row

tasks.notes: The whole-document arc is the thing the probe could not test: an executive summary that matches the conclusions, cross-references that resolve, a SETUP chunk the agent derives from the helper inventory. If the agent writes <<NEEDS>> for a value that has no helper, that is real: extend _pcpkg.py/doe_report.py (a helper task, `make test` must stay 95+), rebuild the brief, and re-invoke the SAME agent with the new helper's name — never a fresh agent mid-document, never a typed number. Never open the shipped PCR-007 in the session that talks to the agent. Expect one to three check_render passes; record the number, it is data.

tasks.title: Content review before the reading: the four questions on the draft, at most one return to the author
acceptance: a fresh-context agent (model recorded), given exactly the prompt of ../2026-08-18_03_author-facing-apparatus/procedures/REVIEW-BEFORE-PROMOTION.md and the DRAFT's PDF and nothing else, reports the flagged sentences per question, verbatim, and the four yes/no answers; filed as content-review-PCR-007-draft.md (run 1)

if any question reads 'no': the SAME authoring agent (the TASK-002 context) is re-invoked ONCE with the flagged sentences quoted as what the section lacks — never as a phrase to insert, never with a count — and re-runs check_render itself; then a second fresh judge repeats the review (run 2), filed below run 1; the DRAFT is re-rendered to pdf and glyph-checked
if every question reads 'yes' at run 1, no return cycle: say so

the outcome states run-1 and run-2 counts per question with the sentences (e.g. 'Q4: 9 -> 3'), and the disposition — 'promotable on content' when the four read yes or every no has been answered in one cycle; otherwise 'not promotable on content', which does not stop TASK-004 (the owner reads whatever the pipeline produced in one cycle) but is recorded
`git status --short pc_package/` still shows only the DRAFT and its renders
tasks.notes: This is the pipeline's own review step, and it is what the reading judges. One cycle only: the calibration (predecessor, content-review-calibration.md) showed the judge is stricter than the owner and consistent, so a second cycle would be tuning the draft to the judge. The judge must not have read the guide, any counter, or the shipped PCR-007. Keep the run-1 draft (`cp` to $U/PCR-007_cex.DRAFT.run1.qmd) so the results page can say what one cycle changed.
